description: This file defines the PHP class 'JobTitle' which extends 'FilterField' and implements 'ValueXNormalizable'. It is part of the report filter fields for the OrangeHRM system, specifically handling operations related to job titles within the reporting filter framework.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: Represents a report filter field for job titles within the OrangeHRM reporting module, enabling addition of query conditions and conversion to array format for UI or API use.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the provided QueryBuilderWrapper by adding a condition to filter by job title if the operator is EQUAL and the filter value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases involved in the query, in this case, the 'employee' alias.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about the job title using the JobTitleService and returns it as an array with 'id' and 'label' keys, or null if not found.
